Markets.title: US stocks today: US stocks close lower as oil prices jump, indexes notch monthly gains
Markets.summary: US stocks closed lower on Monday due to surging oil prices and hawkish comments from Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh, which heightened inflation and rate hike concerns. Despite the daily decline, major indexes still recorded monthly gains for August.

Markets.title: US SEC chairman moves to give states power over shareholder resolutions
Markets.summary: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission is considering rule changes that would give states power over shareholder resolutions. This shift could increase share ownership requirements for investors and reduce activist influence on corporations.

Markets.title: JP Morgan traders back down bullishness on US stocks after Fed chair Warsh's Jackson Hole speech
Markets.summary: JPMorgan Chase traders have adopted a tactically cautious outlook on US stocks following Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh's hawkish comments on interest rates at Jackson Hole. They cite ongoing uncertainty regarding the rate outlook and the potential unwinding of artificial intelligence stocks as key risks to the market.

Markets.title: US 10-year Treasury yield tops 19-month high as oil prices fuel rate-hike bets
Markets.summary: US 10-year Treasury yields rose above 4.75 percent as rising oil prices and inflation fueled expectations of a Federal Reserve rate increase. Investors are now closely watching upcoming employment and consumer price data for further policy clues.

Markets.title: Longer-dated US Treasury yields climb as Iran and US restart military attacks
Markets.summary: Longer-dated U.S. Treasury yields rose as escalating hostilities between the U.S. and Iran pushed crude oil prices higher and fueled inflation concerns. This geopolitical tension and comments from Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh led investors to anticipate a potential September interest rate hike.

Markets.title: ITC Infotech to merge with Happiest Minds, buy 22% promoter stake for Rs 1,330 crore
Markets.summary: ITC Infotech is acquiring a 22% promoter stake in Happiest Minds Technologies for Rs 1,330 crore and merging with the company. This deal creates India's eleventh largest listed IT services firm by revenue, with the combined entity aiming to become an AI-first enterprise by fiscal year 2028.

Geo-Political.title: Nepal rescuers blast hillside in search of hydropower workers as families wait anxiously
Geo-Political.summary: Rescuers in Nepal are using explosives to reach trapped hydropower workers as the flooding death toll reaches 939. Families are waiting anxiously for news of their missing loved ones.

Geo-Political.title: US singer D4vd's celebrity lawyers withdraw from murder case
Geo-Political.summary: US singer D4vd will be represented by a public defender after his celebrity lawyers withdrew from his murder trial. He has pleaded not guilty to the murder of 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez.

Geo-Political.title: Man arrested after Swiss rave shooting that killed woman
Geo-Political.summary: A 22-year-old Italian woman was killed and several others were injured during a shooting at a techno rave in Aarau, Switzerland. Authorities have arrested a man in connection with the attack.

Geo-Political.title: 'She slipped out of my hand' - children missing after ferry sinks off northern Cyprus
Geo-Political.summary: Eight people died and 20 others are missing after a ferry sank off the coast of northern Cyprus. Ayten and Hayri Bicer's two young children are among the missing passengers.

Geo-Political.title: US and Iran trade strikes for first time in weeks
Geo-Political.summary: The United States and Iran have exchanged military strikes for the first time in weeks. A U.S. attack on Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz killed two people and injured two others.

Geo-Political.title: US Supreme Court clears way for Trump to keep building White House ballroom
Geo-Political.summary: The US Supreme Court allowed Donald Trump to continue construction on a White House ballroom. Chief Justice John Roberts dissented, stating that the construction is likely unlawful.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: A creator discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best course in that category. This traffic was generated without any paid advertising or traditional search engine optimization.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights the top 10 artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These essential technologies help digital creators streamline their workflows and stay ahead in a rapidly evolving landscape.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article explores ten of the most advanced and widely used artificial intelligence tools in 2023. These technologies are designed to automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and increase productivity across various industries.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: The article discusses the benefits of using AI content generators to efficiently create engaging and relevant material for audiences. It notes that numerous tools are available on the market, making it challenging to choose the right one.

AI & Tech.title: Beginner Guide to CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction) in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This beginner's guide to CJ Affiliate explains how the network works and how to earn money on the platform. It also highlights top CJ affiliate programs and alternative options for users.

Data & Insights.title: AI cyber risk is biggest immediate threat to global financial system, warns Bank of England chief
Data & Insights.summary: Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey warned that advanced artificial intelligence poses the greatest immediate threat to the global financial system. He stated that rapid AI development could help attackers identify and exploit cyber vulnerabilities in financial institutions and critical systems more quickly.

Data & Insights.title: Finance ministry flags global bond yield, inflation risks for India
Data & Insights.summary: The finance ministry warned that global bond yields and inflation pose risks to India's economy amid external headwinds. Despite these challenges, domestic economic momentum remained strong with robust demand and external stability in August.

Data & Insights.title: Bessent, Warsh host G20 finance ministers: Capital, banks and economic sanctions on Iran in focus
Data & Insights.summary: US officials Bessent and Warsh hosted G20 finance ministers to discuss capital, banking, and economic sanctions on Iran. Warsh stated that a surge in global investment is powering growth by bringing idle capital back into play.

Data & Insights.title: India's growth remains resilient despite global uncertainties, West Asia tensions: CEA Nageswaran hails 7.8% GDP growth
Data & Insights.summary: India's real GDP grew by 7.8% in the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, driven by strong manufacturing, services, exports, and consumption. Chief Economic Adviser V Anantha Nageswaran stated that this performance demonstrates strong economic resilience despite global uncertainties and West Asia tensions.

Data & Insights.title: Real estate powers services sector in June; retail and IT post double-digit gains — what govt data shows
Data & Insights.summary: Government data from MoSPI shows that the real estate sector drove growth in the services industry during June. Retail, wholesale trade, and IT services also experienced double-digit growth.

Data & Insights.title: $74.6 Billion investment in 6 years: Gujarat CM Bhupendra Patel makes fresh pitch to global players
Data & Insights.summary: Gujarat Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel announced that the state attracted $74.6 billion in investments between January 2000 and March 2026. During a fresh pitch to global players, he highlighted Gujarat's emergence as a premier global investment destination.

India.title: Anna Hazare Admitted To ICU In Mumbai Due To Viral Infection, Dehydration
India.summary: Social activist Anna Hazare has been admitted to the ICU in Mumbai. He is currently under constant medical observation for a viral infection and dehydration.

India.title: 25-Year-Old Man Arrested For Killing Wife Over Dowry In UP
India.summary: A 25-year-old man in Uttar Pradesh was arrested for allegedly killing his wife following dowry harassment. The arrest was made after the victim's father, Ram Ghulam, filed a written police complaint on August 28.

India.title: Akali-BJP Experiment Gets Students' Stamp Ahead Of Punjab Polls
India.summary: ABVP candidate Ankit Vidhan won the Panjab University Campus Students Council presidential election. His victory came with the backing of the Shiromani Akali Dal's student wing, the Students Organisation of India.

India.title: Bihar Couple, 3 Children Injured In Acid Attack Over Financial Dispute
India.summary: A couple and their three children were injured in an acid attack in Bihar on August 29. The attack resulted from a heated argument between the two sides regarding a financial dispute.

India.title: 8-Year Jail For Conman Sukesh Chandrasekhar For Posing As Top Court Judge
India.summary: Conman Sukesh Chandrasekhar has been sentenced to eight years in prison for impersonating a top court judge. The court described the crime as profoundly disturbing because it undermined the judiciary, a foundational pillar of democracy.

India.title: Who To Blame For Indore's Water Deaths? 600-Page Report Has Answers
India.summary: A judicial commission led by retired judge Justice Sushil Kumar Gupta has finished investigating the Bhagirathpura contaminated-water incident in Indore. The findings have been compiled into a 600-page report that determines responsibility for the deaths.

General.title: Mel Stride and Priti Patel replaced in major Tory reshuffle
General.summary: Conservative Party leader Kemi Badenoch is replacing Mel Stride and Priti Patel as part of a major frontbench reshuffle. The changes to her top team take place ahead of the party's conference in October.

General.title: Nepal rescuers blast hillside in search of hydropower workers as families wait anxiously
General.summary: Rescuers in Nepal used explosives to search for trapped hydropower workers after severe flooding occurred. The flooding death toll has reached 939 while families anxiously wait for updates.

General.title: Messi retires from international football with 'nothing left to give'
General.summary: Lionel Messi has announced his retirement from international football with Argentina. He stated that the decision hurts, but he feels the time has come to step down.

General.title: Hundreds remember Heaton Park synagogue attack victims at memorial event
General.summary: The chief rabbi and Angela Rayner are among speakers at the event, nearly a year on from the attack.

General.title: AI could cause global economic downturn, Bank of England chief warns
General.summary: The governor of the Bank of England warned of AI's “volatility” caused by energy shocks from the US-Iran war.

General.title: Victoria Beckham's company makes its first profit after 18 years
General.summary: Victoria Beckham's fashion and beauty business has recorded an operating profit of £7.3 million. This marks the company's first annual profit after 18 years of previous losses.
